steps.name: Oath of the Rose (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Veled] in "Phobos", then find [Atkina] in the "Dragon Valley".

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What brings you here? I didn't think we'd meet again so soon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing in particular... Whenever something big ends, I seem to come back to the place where it happened.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Is something worrying you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, just... But what's wrong with you, Veled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: With me...?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I don't know about anyone else, but I feel I should tell you.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I never thought I lacked anything in beauty or character, but what happened made me realize something.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm incomplete. I need to become more whole.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ordinary humans are like that too.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Really? But I'm different from them. I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thank you. Anyway, I'll go on living and searching for the reason. But I feel impatient. I know it won't be easy. Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything that might help, even a little...? Why not ask Lord Atkina for advice?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, I hadn't thought of that. Hearing some wise words from Uncle Atkina might help.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'd like to go with you, but there's a problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I can't enter the Dragon Valley. Adrica might be all right, but deeper places like the valley recognize me as an unholy being and keep me out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So when Uncle Atkina calls for me, we meet at the border between Phobos and Adrica and chat...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it will have to be me. Someone has to go...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You don't mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all. I agreed to stay in the Dragon Valley for a few days, so I need to return anyway.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's not urgent. Come tell me what he says when you have time. Then I can tell you about my beauty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Off you go, %s. Why do you always turn down the chance to hear about my beauty?

steps.name: Oath of the Rose (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Evil Iris] in the "Chaos Canyon" and obtain a <Spirit Wing>. Then report to [Peonia] in "Mars".

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I wondered where you had gone. You visited Veled.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I just felt like I should stop by Phobos. Oh, right. Veled...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Atkina about Veled's concerns.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Veled is giving considerable thought to her own existence. That is important for every living being.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I would like to help, but what can a dragon do? If only Veled could feel more secure...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, perhaps...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you think of something?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Trust may be the answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Trust?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If someone Veled cherishes pledges their trust in her, she will feel less anxious. The goddess is that person for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see... Then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Would that be Iris for me?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes. The person who just came to mind is the one you trust. Then the answer is simple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. For Veled, that person would be Peonia. You know her too, don't you?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I've heard of her. A woman of steadfast beauty who embodies the spirit of Phobos. She even scolds Valdrick without hesitation...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Peonia must also have trust in Veled. Bring her the item I name, and she will understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What item?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A Spirit Wing, found only in the Inner World. There is no hurry. Take your time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I found one in the Chaos Canyon before... Shall I look there?)

steps.name: Oath of the Rose (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Asmodea] in "Rosengarten" and obtain the <Reverse-Side Red Rose Pendant>. Then report to [Peonia] in "Mars".

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: ...Welcome. I'm a little busy, but I have time to talk to you. I did expect we'd meet again soon...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina asked me to give you this...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Atkina, the Champion...? Or should I say champion dragon? Anyway, what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said you'd understand when you received it. I don't know exactly what he meant...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Then let me have it.
(Peonia gazes at the Spirit Wing in %s's hand, then takes it.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: What's happening? The wing's moving on its own and flying away. That's where Veled is...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I don't quite understand, but am I supposed to do something for Veled? What did Atkina say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said trust.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Trust?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. He said you should pledge your trust in her.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I don't doubt Veled. But I want to show her I believe in her...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to prove it. An action or a gift might express that better than words.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Could you find another pendant like the one Veled has?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I'm not sure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, maybe... There could be another space. Similar, but different...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Dayna said there might be things I only discovered because I went there...)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Is it difficult? You don't have to...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I think I can find one.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: All right... Then please do.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: You're back already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's what you asked for. I found it in an ominous place, but it should be safe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't sense any power in it. It's simply an ornament, nothing more.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Thank you, %s.
(Peonia puts on the pendant she received from %s.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: This pendant is pretty.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: When Veled wore it, I thought it was just an ordinary rose ornament.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It suits you.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Oh, thanks... As long as it helps Veled...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. I'm managing to sort out the aftermath of the mayor's actions, too...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Someone from the Alliance of Light came recently. They wanted to restore the ties we'd cut. It felt as though Lord Ziskad had been waiting for us...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's a good person.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Yes, I could tell. But what could Mayor Klaus have been thinking...?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I don't understand.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I thought at least the side of him I knew had been real...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know much about him, but what do the other residents say?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: They're split down the middle. His supporters say he'd never do something like that. The people who disliked him say they knew it all along.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: We have evidence and witnesses... It's just that the witnesses are Veled and Uncle Valdrick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes things complicated.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: It's all right. I'll work it out somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure you will, Peonia. It's reassuring.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Thank you for saying that. When the time is right, I'll visit Veled and show her this. Please thank Lord Atkina for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.
(Peonia lifts the pendant around her neck and stares at it.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Peonia, you can do this. There are people who believe in you and depend on you. You mustn't falter. For everyone who trusts you...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Veled...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: By the way, I haven't seen you two before. Are you troubleshooters? We won't be posting monster or demon extermination requests for a while.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Ahaha. You noticed us? How did you spot us? We're not troubleshooters. As you can see...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: (A moon tattoo on his neck...)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: A gift. Freshly made caramel cake.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: We only just arrived. How did you manage that?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Let's call it a family secret. There's some for you too, Raclette. Eat as much as you like.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: I hate sweets. That's why I didn't want to come with you... And mentioning your family brings back things I'd rather forget. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Enough of the comedy routine. Tell me why you've come.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Moonlight...

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: That makes things easier. Please find somewhere we can talk privately.
